purpose: Eight user controls across the six HIDE memory classes, with personal scopes orthogonal to class, portable export, and real deletion. No hidden permanent memory.

module.rationale: Six class stores and capability-typed writes already live here; controls extend that substrate rather than inventing a seventh store.

write_authority_unchanged.law: Do not weaken any existing write-authority type.
write_authority_unchanged.correct_honours_authority: correct_verification still requires VerifierWriteCap; correct_user requires UserWriteCap; etc. Authority is stamped by the write method, not the draft.

personal_scopes.law: Scope is orthogonal to class. A record has exactly one class and exactly one scope. Connector-scoped content never becomes global without an explicit, recorded promotion.

user_controls.law: No hidden permanent memory. Every durable record is reachable by inspect and removable by forget, and forget is real deletion for user-scoped data rather than a tombstone.

correct.semantics: supersession: new record names old via supersedes; both remain until forgotten

apis.pin: pin(id, pinned) — exempt from expire, never from forget
apis.forget: forget(id) / forget_scope(scope) — real DELETE from SQLite/RAM, not a tombstone
apis.export: export() → MemoryExport schema hide.you.memory_export.v1 (JSON-serializable without this tool)
apis.disable: disable_class(class, bool) — blocks new writes and compile retrieval; records stay inspectable/forgettable

export.readable_without_this_tool: serde JSON; ClassMemoryRecord is fully serializable

deletion.evict_session: DELETE episodic (and other tables) WHERE session_id = ?

tests.name: property_no_hidden_permanent_memory_inspect_and_forget
tests.proves: every durable record inspectable; forget real-deletes user data; export round-trips as JSON

tests.name: property_correct_verification_requires_verifier_cap
tests.proves: correct on verification still stamps Verifier authority and requires the cap

tests.name: property_scope_orthogonal_to_class_and_promotion_recorded
tests.proves: class+scope product; connector not global until explicit promotion with approver

tests.name: property_pin_expire_disable_controls
tests.proves: pin survives expire; disable blocks write+compile; inspect still sees records

tests.name: property_export_and_real_deletion_path
tests.proves: export contains record; forget removes from store and subsequent export

tests.name: property_eight_scopes_closed_vocabulary
tests.proves: exactly eight scopes; parse is closed

tests.name: property_user_db_legacy_schema_migrates_idempotently
tests.proves: PRAGMA table_info + ALTER migrates an existing user.db that lacks control columns; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS alone is insufficient

tests.name: property_forget_clears_dangling_edges_and_export
tests.proves: forget deletes the row, supersedes pointers, and scope-promotion rows; subsequent export retains no residual of the forgotten id

tests.name: property_export_carries_no_capability_and_no_reimport_path
tests.proves: export JSON has no tools/connectors grant vocabulary; deserializing a stale export does not rehydrate the store

non_goals: No real network, credentials, or model
Production writers still not fully wired into SubmitTurn (prior memory-classes gap)
Vault encryption is a handle boundary; platform crypto at rest is deferred
